description:
Notice: The anticipated solicitation method for this requirement is direct solicitation of quotations from vendors. The Government does not intend to issue a formal written solicitation. Quotations will be requested via oral and/or email communication. 

Interested vendors are encouraged to respond to this notice with their capability and contact information by 30 April 2026, at 1:00PM MST to be considered for the upcoming solicitation. 

Cannon AFB is requesting a 24 inch Cold Planer compatible with CAT 299C high-flow skid steer that must meet the below specifications:

Depth of cut – 0-6 inches

Width of cut – 24 inches

Number of teeth – 60

Side Shift – 24 inches (hydraulic)

Tilt – 16 degrees

Hydraulic requirement – 22-56 GPM/3000-6525 psi

Depth and tilt control – Hydraulic

Factory Installed High Flow Couplers

Wire Harness Cat "C" Series 8 Pin

Case Drain Coupler (female)
